item.title: Show HN: Your next startup, ready in the blink of an eye
item.summary: Over this past weekend I built a web app called Blink Ideas. It finds customer complaints and feedback on places like HN, StackExchange, app store reviews, and more. Then it generates real startup solutions, scored with their investment opportunity based risk, market appeal, scalability, and other major factors. It provides a solution, MVP, and even competitor list to help you gain insights before building. Now more than ever, starting a business or building an app is the easy part. Creating something that makes money that people actually want is the hard part. That's why I built this app. It makes starting your next side project or startup a piece of cake, saving weeks or months of research and helping you build something people actually use. It makes building worth your while and will deliver you a return on your time and effort. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49176613 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
